top_signals.title: Dimon Says If You Try to Game the Market, You'll Lose
top_signals.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Chief Executive Officer Jamie Dimon says investors should get used to the fact that markets go up and down. He says if you try to game the market, you are guaranteed to lose money. He speaks exclusively with Tom Mackenzie at JPMorgan’s Tech Stars Conference in London. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Brazil Market Euphoria Hinges on Fixes Flávio Bolsonaro Is Yet to Lay Out
top_signals.summary: Investors are betting Brazil’s election-fueled rally has just begun — a wager that ultimately hinges on a fiscal overhaul markets have long demanded, but still know little about.
